tools.name: start_build
tools.description: Use this when the user wants a live preview website for a local service business AND has typed business_name, email, and phone in THIS chat. tools.name: get_preview
tools.description: Use this after start_build. If status is ready, send preview_url immediately. If keep_polling is true or preview_url is null, call get_preview again with the same token. A progress card may appear and refresh itself. Pass wait=false only for a progress-card refresh. Do not start_build again.

tools.name: create_checkout
tools.description: Use this when the owner wants the preview site live. Returns a Stripe Checkout URL. Send that URL. Do not collect card numbers. Preview must be ready. Price is in the result.

tools.name: get_live_site
tools.description: Use this after the owner pays. If they have not paid, returns live=false and the preview URL.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "public" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: start_build, get_live_site · Private data: get_preview · Public sink: start_build, get_preview, create_checkout.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: start_build, get_live_site · Private data: get_preview · Public sink: start_build, get_preview, create_checkout

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
